## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and the scope of this change.
Link the relevant issue or architecture decision when available.

## Owner and review

Relevant owners (use confirmed GitHub handles when requesting review):

- Thịnh — Project Lead
- Khoa — DevOps & Frontend
- Trí — Data & Evaluation
- Long — AWS & Backend
- Hùng — Computer Vision

## Validation

List the commands actually run, their results, and the relevant CI run or artifact
links. Clearly identify checks not run and any limitations. Unit-test results do
not establish model performance or successful AWS deployment.

## Data, model, or infrastructure impact

Describe any dataset/split changes, experiment provenance, API changes, AWS
resources, expected costs, and teardown. Write "None" where appropriate. Separate
planned work and example values from measured or deployed outcomes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope and responsible owner are clear.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests are updated.
- [ ] Validation reports only checks and results actually observed.
- [ ] No credentials, raw datasets, model weights, or infrastructure state are included.
- [ ] Relevant owners have been asked to review; merge requires team approval.
